name: flux-schnell-l0
description: FLUX.1-schnell L0 representative at 384px with full text shape and reduced image scale

notes: PR L0 repro for FLUX.1-schnell. Uses the same checkpoint, CLIP+T5 encoders, FluxDiT/VAE path, runner, comparator, and image artifact contract. L0 keeps the full 256-token text shape, uses a 384px image to reduce DiT/VAE scale, and uses twenty denoising steps.
